FN-2WE6IK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 65
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/17/2023
House Bill 65 as introduced increases the competitive bidding floor for county and city boards
of education from $15,000, under current law, to $25,000. This may increase or decrease the
cost of purchasing or leasing products and services, depending on the difference in (1) the price
that could be obtained from competitive bidding contracts pursuant to this bill and (2) the price
otherwise obtained under current law.

FN-2WE6IK-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 65
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Terri Collins
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/22/2023
House Bill 65 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education increases the
competitive bidding floor for county and city boards of education from $15,000, under current
law, to $40,000. In addition, this bill authorizes the threshold to be increased based on the
percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index. This may increase or decrease the cost of
purchasing or leasing products and services, depending on the difference in (1) the price that
could be obtained from competitive bidding contracts pursuant to this bill and (2) the price
otherwise obtained under current law.
